terms.definitionEn: A property that sets the foreground paint used for text and other decorations.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد اللون الأمامي اللي بيتعرض بيه النص والزخارف.

terms.definitionEn: A hexadecimal notation for specifying red, green, and blue channels, optionally with alpha.
terms.definitionAr: صيغة بالنظام الست عشري لتحديد قنوات الأحمر والأخضر والأزرق وممكن الشفافية.

terms.definitionEn: A color function that specifies red, green, and blue channel values.
terms.definitionAr: دالة ألوان بتحدد قيم قنوات الأحمر والأخضر والأزرق.

terms.definitionEn: A property that paints a solid color behind an element's content and padding.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحط لونًا ثابتًا خلف محتوى العنصر والـ padding.

terms.definitionEn: A property that specifies an ordered list of typefaces and generic family choices.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد قائمة مرتبة من الخطوط وعائلات الخطوط العامة.

terms.definitionEn: A color function using hue, saturation, and lightness components.
terms.definitionAr: دالة ألوان بتستخدم درجة اللون والتشبع والإضاءة.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets the size of glyphs in an element's text.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد حجم الحروف اللي بتظهر في نص العنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A property that selects the stroke thickness of text from styles offered by a typeface.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتختار درجة سُمك الحروف من الأوزان المتاحة للخط.

terms.definitionEn: A property that controls the height of a line box used to lay out text.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتتحكم في ارتفاع صندوق السطر المستخدم لترتيب النص.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets inline content alignment within a block container.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد محاذاة المحتوى اللي جوه السطر داخل حاوية block.

terms.definitionEn: A relative length unit based on the computed font size of the root element.
terms.definitionAr: وحدة طول نسبية بتعتمد على حجم الخط المحسوب للعنصر الجذر.

terms.definitionEn: A relative length unit whose reference depends on the property and node, often the node's text size when sizing text.
terms.definitionAr: وحدة طول نسبية مرجعها بيعتمد على الخاصية والعنصر، وغالبًا حجم خط العنصر عند تحديد النص.

questions.question: Which part of the text styling does color set?
options: The width of each letter within the font
The space between two lines of text
The background behind the whole page
questions.explanation: color sets the foreground color for text and related decorations.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية color بتحدد اللون الأمامي للنص والزخارف المرتبطة بيه.

questions.question: What does this declaration paint?
options: The text's font weight and style
The color of every descendant link
questions.explanation: background-color paints a solid color behind the element's content and padding.
questions.explanationAr: background-color بتحط لون ثابت خلف محتوى العنصر والـ padding.

questions.question: Why list a generic family after a named typeface?
options: To make the text use two typefaces at once
To set a second font size
questions.explanation: Browsers use the first available family in the list and can fall back to the generic family.
questions.explanationAr: المتصفح بيستخدم أول خط متاح في القائمة وممكن يرجع للعائلة العامة.

questions.question: What does the numeric value request?
options: Text aligned 700 units from the edge
questions.explanation: Numeric font-weight values select a weight, with supported values depending on the font.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة font-weight الرقمية بتختار سُمك الخط حسب الأوزان المتاحة.

questions.question: What computed font size does .note get?
questions.explanation: 1.5 times the root font size of 16px is 24px.
questions.explanationAr: واحد ونص في حجم خط الجذر 16px يساوي 24px.

questions.prompt: Set this heading's text size to two root-relative units.
questions.explanation: font-size controls the size of text glyphs.
questions.explanationAr: font-size بتتحكم في حجم الحروف.

questions.prompt: Request a bold numeric weight for this label.
questions.explanation: A numeric font-weight can request a heavier style when the font provides it.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة font-weight رقمية ممكن تطلب خط أتقل لو الوزن متاح.

questions.question: Which spacing does this value primarily control?
options: The height of each line box
The width of the text column
questions.explanation: line-height controls the height of line boxes and the vertical rhythm of text.
questions.explanationAr: line-height بتحدد ارتفاع صناديق السطور والإيقاع الرأسي للنص.

questions.question: What is centered by this declaration?
options: The h2 element's border box in its parent
Every block child in the whole page
The page viewport around the heading
questions.explanation: text-align aligns inline content inside the element, not the block element itself.
questions.explanationAr: text-align بتحاذي المحتوى داخل العنصر، مش صندوق العنصر نفسه.

questions.question: Which computed color wins for the paragraph?
questions.explanation: The matching class rule overrides the type rule for this paragraph's color.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة الـ class المطابقة بتغلب قاعدة نوع العنصر في لون الفقرة.

questions.prompt: Specify a hue of 210 degrees, 60 percent saturation, and 40 percent lightness.
questions.explanation: hsl() expresses a color with hue, saturation, and lightness components.
questions.explanationAr: hsl() بتحدد اللون بدرجة اللون والتشبع والإضاءة.

questions.prompt: Set a solid ivory fill behind the main content.
questions.explanation: background-color paints the element's background with a solid color.
questions.explanationAr: background-color بتلون خلفية العنصر بلون ثابت.

questions.question: For this padding value, what does 1em use as its reference?
options: The root element's font size in every property
questions.explanation: For padding lengths, em is based on the element's computed font size.
questions.explanationAr: في padding، وحدة em بتعتمد على حجم الخط المحسوب للعنصر.

questions.prompt: Center inline text inside the heading.
questions.explanation: text-align controls inline content alignment within the block.
questions.explanationAr: text-align بتتحكم في محاذاة المحتوى داخل block.

questions.question: What does the final percentage represent in this color function?
questions.explanation: The slash-separated fourth component in modern rgb() syntax sets alpha.
questions.explanationAr: المكوّن الرابع بعد الشرطة المائلة في rgb() بيحدد الشفافية.

questions.prompt: Provide a system interface font with a sans-serif fallback.
questions.explanation: A generic family at the end provides a broad fallback choice.
questions.explanationAr: العائلة العامة في آخر القائمة بتوفر اختيارًا احتياطيًا واسعًا.

questions.question: Which font-weight value wins for this heading?
questions.explanation: The class selector is more specific than the type selector, so its font-weight wins.
questions.explanationAr: الـ class selector أعلى specificity من type selector، فقيمته هي اللي بتكسب.

questions.question: What value does currentColor use for this border?
options: The first color in the stylesheet
questions.explanation: currentColor refers to the element's computed color property.
questions.explanationAr: currentColor بترجع لقيمة color المحسوبة للعنصر.

questions.prompt: Set a fluid heading size with a 1rem minimum, 4vw preferred size, and 3rem maximum.
questions.explanation: clamp() constrains a preferred value between a minimum and maximum.
questions.explanationAr: clamp() بتحصر القيمة المفضلة بين حد أدنى وحد أقصى.

questions.prompt: Set comfortable unitless line spacing that scales with the text size.
questions.explanation: A unitless line-height scales with the element's font size and is inherited as a multiplier.
questions.explanationAr: line-height من غير وحدة بيتناسب مع حجم الخط وبيتورث كمعامل.

questions.question: Compare hexadecimal, rgb(), and hsl() color notations.
keyPoints: Each notation can express colors in CSS
RGB uses red, green, and blue channels
HSL uses hue, saturation, and lightness
Alpha can represent transparency in supported syntax
questions.modelAnswer: Hexadecimal and rgb() describe red, green, and blue channel values, while hsl() uses hue, saturation, and lightness. Modern forms can also include alpha to express transparency.
questions.explanation: The notations represent colors using different coordinate systems.
questions.explanationAr: الصيغ المختلفة بتمثل اللون بإحداثيات مختلفة، وممكن كمان تضيف الشفافية.

questions.question: How should a robust font-family declaration handle unavailable fonts?
keyPoints: The browser selects an available face
questions.modelAnswer: List preferred typefaces from most specific to more general, ending with a suitable generic family. If a family is unavailable or lacks a glyph, the browser may use a later choice or another fallback.
questions.explanation: Ordered fallback choices make text rendering more resilient across systems.
questions.explanationAr: ترتيب الخطوط مع عائلة عامة في الآخر بيخلي العرض أضمن على أجهزة مختلفة.

questions.question: When might rem and em be useful, and how do their references differ?
keyPoints: rem references the root font size
em's reference depends on the property and element
Relative sizing can scale with text settings
Nested em font sizes can compound
questions.modelAnswer: rem is based on the root element's computed font size, while em depends on the property and element where it is used. Relative units can support scalable designs, but nested font-size values in em can compound.
questions.explanation: The units are both relative but use different references in common cases.
questions.explanationAr: الوحدتين نسبيتين لكن مرجعهم مختلف في الاستخدام الشائع.

questions.question: How do line-height and text-align affect text layout differently?
keyPoints: text-align positions inline content within a line
Neither property necessarily centers the block itself
questions.modelAnswer: line-height changes the vertical size of line boxes and affects the spacing of text lines. text-align controls how inline content is aligned within the element, rather than centering the block box itself.
questions.explanation: One property affects vertical line metrics; the other aligns inline content.
questions.explanationAr: الأولى بتأثر على ارتفاع السطور، والتانية بتحاذي المحتوى داخلها.
